meta.title: ASME B36.10M (carbon / alloy steel, schedules 5..160, STD, XS, XXS) and ASME B36.19M (stainless, 5S..80S) pipe outside diameter and nominal wall, mm
meta.source: S1: fluids 1.3.1 (PyPI sdist fluids-1.3.1.tar.gz, sha256 42014b5f7d0ee3a5c6fea05582cdc37975e7c46d4c864feb6c7cb915df8a1972, 2210067 bytes), module fluids/piping.py, lists NPS*/S*o/S*t (comment: 'Schedules 5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140, 160 from ASME B36.10M'; 'Schedules 10, 40 and 80 from ASME B36.19M'). Extracted with ast.literal_eval (no code executed).

meta.crossCheck: S2: formulab 0.72.3 (npm, MIT, dist/metal/pipeSpec.js) for SCH5/10/40/80/160/XXS NPS 1/2..16: 86 rows agree (wall 0.005 mm, OD 0.15 mm); 2 rows differ (Sch 10 NPS 14 and 16: formulab 4.78 = the B36.19M 10S wall; fluids 6.35 = B36.10M Sch 10). Rows marked 'S2 agrees' are grade A; other rows grade B (one open-source transcription) unless a VC names another source.
notes: OD is fixed per NPS within a standard; B36.10M prints NPS 12 as 323.8 mm, EN 10220 / B36.19M 323.9 (12.750 in = 323.85 mm).
B36.19M 5S/10S/40S/80S differ from B36.10M Sch 5/10/40/80 for some NPS 10..22 (S3 search extract, SFS store page).
Plain-end mass is not tabulated here: it is the closed form m = 0.0246615 (D - t) t kg/m (see component_references.json, massFormula).
